style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#F9FAFB;strokeColor=#6B7280;spacing=8;rounded=1;arcSize=3;" value="<b>Plan A is drawn</b> (RDS and S3). Plan B, if RDS and S3 are not approved: PostgreSQL and MinIO run in the cluster. langfuse-web and langfuse-worker both use RDS, ClickHouse, Redis and S3. Only the load balancer is reachable from the internet: HTTPS 443, the jobs only from their Cloud NAT egress IPs. Secrets come from the Kubernetes secret store; the dashboard allowlist is a ConfigMap. One RDS instance for both databases is to decide (plan A in S3-06 has one instance for each)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="1540" x="360" y="895" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e16" edge="1" parent="1" source="backend" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;strokeColor=#232F3E;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#232F3E;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=1;exitY=0.85;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.85;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="lfweb" value="HTTP 3000 (spans, scores)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="-0.4" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1060" y="367.6" /> <mxPoint x="1060" y="540" /> <mxPoint x="970" y="540" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Plan A is drawn (RDS and S3). Plan B, if RDS and S3 are not approved: PostgreSQL and MinIO run in the cluster. langfuse-web and langfuse-worker both use RDS, ClickHouse, Redis and S3. Only the load balancer is reachable from the internet: HTTPS 443, the jobs only from their Cloud NAT egress IPs. Secrets come from the Kubernetes secret store; the dashboard allowlist is a ConfigMap. One RDS instance for both databases is to decide (plan A in S3-06 has one instance for each).

switch.text: Plan A is drawn (RDS and S3). Plan B, if RDS and S3 are not approved: PostgreSQL and MinIO run in the cluster. langfuse-web and langfuse-worker both use RDS, ClickHouse, Redis and S3. Only the load balancer is reachable from the internet: HTTPS 443, the jobs only from their Cloud NAT egress IPs. Secrets...
